name: datasim
description: DataSim: a design-and-load-test studio for database engineers.

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.db:shell: docker compose exec mysql mysql -uroot -proot datasim
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm -w server run dev" "npm -w web run dev"
scripts.test: npm -w shared run test && npm -w server run test && npm -w web run test
scripts.typecheck: npm -w shared run typecheck && npm -w server run typecheck && npm -w web run typecheck
